第90章 特招-《70年代开局，我靠零元购发家》

时间过得很快，一眨眼来到了八月底，自从上次回去后，王建新再没回家。不是他不想回，是他看见父母的样子，他也心里难受，但不知怎么解决。

校园里的杨树叶子还绿着，但早晚的风已经凉了。操场上多了不少生面孔——新一批工农兵学员来报到了，背着行李，拎着网兜，脸上带着兴奋和茫然，跟王建新两年前刚来的时候一模一样。刘晓东站在宿舍窗口往下看，说了一句“又来了一茬新兵蛋子”，被李建国瞪了一眼，缩了缩脖子。

那天下午，王建新正在实验室里看切片。陈怀远教授站在他旁边，指着显微镜下的组织切片，低声讲解着什么。老教授的声音不大，但讲得很细，每一个细胞核的形态、每一处病变的特征，都说得清清楚楚。王建新一边听一边记，笔记写得工工整整。

实验室的门被人敲响了。陈教授去开门，门口站着教导员，气喘吁吁地说：“王建新同志，校革委会主任让你马上去他办公室一趟。”

王建新放下手里的切片，跟陈教授道了别，快步出了实验室。陈教授站在门口，看着他走远的背影，站了好一会儿，才转身回去。

王建新来到主任办公室门口，整了整军帽，敲了敲门。

“进来。”

他推门进去，立正敬礼。革委会主任坐在办公桌后面，手里拿着一份文件，抬起头看了他一眼，脸上带着笑。

“王建新同志，坐。”

王建新在办公桌对面的椅子上坐下，腰板挺得直直的。

革委会主任把一份盖着红色公章的文件推到他面前，文件不长，但抬头印着醒目的红色大字，下面盖着军区和总后勤部的公章。

“上级决定你提前毕业，特招进北京军区总医院，直接定副团级。”

王建新愣了一下。工农兵学员学制三年，入学才两年，还能提前毕业？他张了张嘴，想问什么，主任摆了摆手，示意他先别说话。

“军区总医院里边收治的都是高级干部和重危伤病员。这是上级对你的肯定。”主任用手指点了点桌上的文件，声音不高，但每个字都清清楚楚，“你是工农兵学员里边的先进典型，又有多次立功表现，组织上希望你在新的岗位上做出更大贡献。”

王建新站起来，立正，敬了一个军礼：“谢谢组织培养。”

主任从抽屉里又拿出一个文件袋，递给他，厚厚一沓。“你的任职命令和分配通知。副团级，行政级别定为十五级。总医院对你们这类军医定级别，一般都比地方高两级。你是优秀的学员，也是优秀的大夫。你属于被特招进去，主要是上级领导看重你的医术。”

主任顿了顿，目光从文件上移到王建新的脸上。“去了医院好好工作，继续提升自己。回去收拾收拾东西，就去报到吧。”

王建新再次敬礼：“我服从安排。”

主任站起身，绕过办公桌，走到王建新面前，拍了拍他的肩膀，用力地拍了两下。“你是咱们北医的光荣和骄傲。”

王建新走出办公楼，站在台阶上。阳光很亮，刺得他眯了眯眼。操场上有人在打球，有人在树荫下看书。一切都很平常，跟平时没什么两样。但他的心里不平静。

“提前毕业，副团级，十五级，总医院。”他在心里把这几个词念了一遍，又念了一遍。太快了。从入学到现在，满打满算才两年，在这个年代，这么随意的吗？

他深吸了一口气，走下台阶，先去后勤组把工资领上，然后朝宿舍走去。

Time flies by, and it’s the end of August in the blink of an eye. Since the last time he went back, Wang Jianxin has never returned home.It's not that he doesn't want to go back, it's that he feels uncomfortable when he sees his parents, but he doesn't know how to solve it.

The leaves of the poplar trees on campus are still green, but the morning and evening wind has become cold.There are many new faces on the playground - a new batch of workers, peasants and soldiers students have come to report, carrying luggage and net bags, with excitement and confusion on their faces, exactly the same as when Wang Jianxin came two years ago.Liu Xiaodong stood at the dormitory window, looked down, and said, "Another batch of new recruits has arrived." Li Jianguo glared at him and shrank his neck.

That afternoon, Wang Jianxin was looking at slices in the laboratory.Professor Chen Huaiyuan stood next to him, pointing to the tissue sections under the microscope and explaining something in a low voice.The old professor's voice was not loud, but he spoke very carefully. He clearly explained the shape of each cell nucleus and the characteristics of each lesion.Wang Jianxin took notes while listening, and his notes were written neatly.

There was a knock on the laboratory door.Professor Chen went to open the door, and there was an instructor standing at the door, panting and saying: "Comrade Wang Jianxin, the director of the school revolution committee wants you to go to his office immediately."

Wang Jianxin put down the slices in his hand, said goodbye to Professor Chen, and quickly left the laboratory.Professor Chen stood at the door, watching his walking back. He stood for a while before turning back.

Wang Jianxin came to the door of the director's office, adjusted his military cap, and knocked on the door.

"Come in."

He opened the door and entered, standing at attention and saluting.The director of the Revolutionary Committee was sitting behind his desk, holding a document in his hand. He raised his head and glanced at him with a smile on his face.

"Comrade Wang Jianxin, sit down."

Wang Jianxin sat down on the chair opposite his desk, his back straight.

The director of the Revolutionary Committee pushed a document with a red official seal in front of him. The document was not long, but it had eye-catching red characters on the header, and the official seals of the military region and the General Logistics Department were stamped below.

"Your superiors have decided that you will graduate early and be specially recruited into the Beijing Military Region General Hospital. You will be directly assigned to the deputy regiment level."

Wang Jianxin was stunned for a moment.Workers, peasants and soldiers have a three-year schooling program and only two years of enrollment. How can they graduate early?He opened his mouth to ask something, but the director waved his hand to signal him to stop talking.

"The General Hospital of the Military Region treats senior cadres and critically ill patients. This is the recognition of you from your superiors." The director tapped the documents on the table with his finger. His voice was low, but every word was clear. "You are an advanced model among the workers, peasants and soldiers, and you have performed many meritorious services. The organization hopes that you will make greater contributions in your new position."

Wang Jianxin stood up, stood at attention, and gave a military salute: "Thank you for organizing the training."

The director took out another document bag from the drawer and handed it to him, a thick stack."Your appointment order and assignment notice. Deputy regiment level, administrative level is set at level 15. The general hospital's level for military doctors like you is generally two levels higher than the local level. You are an excellent student and an excellent doctor. You were specially recruited, mainly because the superior leaders value your medical skills."

The director paused and looked from the document to Wang Jianxin's face."Go to the hospital and work hard and continue to improve yourself. Go back and pack your things and report for duty."

Wang Jianxin saluted again: "I obey the arrangement."

The director stood up, walked around the desk, walked to Wang Jianxin, and patted his shoulder twice hard."You are the glory and pride of our Beijing Medical University."

Wang Jianxin walked out of the office building and stood on the steps.The sun was so bright that it made him squint.Some people are playing ball on the playground, and some are reading under the shade of the trees.Everything was normal, no different from usual.But his heart was not at peace.

"Graduate early, deputy regiment level, fifteenth level, general hospital." He read these words in his mind, and then read them again.Too fast.It has only been two years since I entered school. In this day and age, is it so casual?

He took a deep breath, walked down the steps, went to the logistics team to collect his salary, and then walked towards the dormitory.
